items.html: And in Parashat Nasso, page 135b, concerning the pure air and the pure fire, I explained at length the language of that article: how, in the secret of this upper surrounding light, they are four Mochin as mentioned; and upon their subsequent entry into the fifth aspect, within the three cavities of the skull of ZA, they become only three Mochin, for the two coronets joined and became a single brain of Daat.
